hypotheses.S1_earlier_edits_change_final_behavior: Mean native full-token KL is at least 0.001 for every earlier edit position and corpus.
hypotheses.S2_attention_is_material_for_earlier_edi: For every earlier edit position and corpus, some single-layer changed-attention insertion reaches at least 0.10 of native full-token KL.
hypotheses.S3_earlier_edits_depend_more_on_attentio: For every corpus, the best attention/full-KL ratio averaged across earlier edit positions exceeds the final-position best ratio.
hypotheses.S4_source_key_role_grows_with_distance: For every corpus, the maximum absolute local key allocation across layers is larger at position 63 than at position 127.
hypotheses.S5_persistent_value_bus_is_used_for_long: For every corpus, the persistent-bus local allocation reaches at least 0.10 at some layer for the position-63 edit.
hypotheses.S6_material_attention_depth_transfers_oo: For each edit position, the best attention-insertion layer differs by at most two across corpora.
hypotheses.S7_material_attention_has_a_stable_facto: At the best attention-insertion layer for each corpus and edit position, insertion and removal agree on the largest absolute Q/K/current-value/bus factor.
hypotheses.S8_head_additivity_survives_long_range_r: At the best layer for every earlier edit position and corpus, summed isolated-head effects have Fisher fidelity at least 0.75 to the full attention-change intervention.
